tasks.title: src/core/citations.py: ScoredHit, Citation, Answer, NoReliableAnswer, scoring rule and decide(), with unit tests
tasks.done_when: .venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/core/test_citations.py --cov=core.citations --cov-fail-under=100 passes: (1) hit sets (4 or more) give citations whose source_url is valid http(s) and whose confidence is in [0, 1]; (2) decide gives Answer at confidence 0.5 with min 0.5, NoReliableAnswer at 0.49 with min 0.5, Answer at 0.4 with min 0.3; (3) empty hit list and all-invalid-URL hits give NoReliableAnswer with no sources; empty, non-http(s) and credential-bearing URLs are dropped; (4) no rerank score gives confidence = retrieval score, both scores give 0.4*retrieval + 0.6*rerank, and RETRIEVAL_WEIGHT + RERANK_WEIGHT == 1.0 (weight-sum test); (5) bool, NaN, inf and out-of-range scores and min_confidence outside [0, 1] raise ValueError naming the field; (6) Answer.citations sorted by confidence descending, stable on ties, Answer.confidence is the maximum; closest_sources holds at most 3; Answer and NoReliableAnswer carry NOT_LEGAL_ADVICE_NOTICE; (7) the import test passes: the module imports only stdlib and core.notices (no sqlalchemy, httpx, requests, redis, celery, openai); .venv/bin/pyright src/core/citations.py tests/unit/core/test_citations.py reports 0 errors
